reviews.title: I can’t even get it to load since the update?!?
reviews.text: I’ve used this app for years reliably and now I can’t even get it to load? Just spinning on 3 animated dots. Terribly disappointing.

reviews.title: New App doesn’t recognize my email
reviews.text: I’ve had this app since 2008. Have been off of it since last year. Went to log on and it doesn’t recognize the only email address I’ve ever had so therefore i can’t reset my password as it tells me invalid email. Now all my info will be lost if I start a new account which would be useless for me now. Time to look for a better app because this one sucks losing all my logged information.

reviews.title: New version is awful to use
reviews.text: I have also had this app for a decade. The new version is pretty, but that is about all. The worst thing about it is that it won’t save my favorite foods. I can type them in and click save. They aren’t there anymore. I can type in a full recipe, click save. They aren’t there. It is so frustrating. The old app was amazing. I can’t even use this one. If I can’t save my favorites then there’s no point to using it. The label scanner is nice, but I’m not doing that with every item I eat. I need to be able to have favorites.

reviews.title: Garbage
reviews.text: Waste of money. Even their feedback does not work. They should refund every single customer

reviews.title: update broke app
reviews.text: your latest update completely broke the app. Great job. it is completely unusable now. Nothing opens up and I lost all the data that had been saved. The original version was perfect. I don’t know why you’ve changed it around. Your latest update made the whole app unusable not just parts. Great job

reviews.title: Lost access
reviews.text: I paid for this app years ago and loved it. Used it for years. I woke up one day and the app was gone, replaced with whatever this is and I can't even log in anymore.

reviews.title: Update Ruined 15 Years of Data
reviews.text: Been using app for nearly 15 years.   Was always simple, straightforward & did not require username/password.  Recent update caused lack of access to 15 years worth of data.  No warning.  No heads up.  Now it’s bloated & overly complicated.      Better apps out there.
